column1: # Routes of the paper's proofs, for scripts/route_check.py: label, environment, whether the paper
# proves it, and the labels of the results that its proof cites.
# Written by hand from the published version (Applied Network Science 10, 15, 2025), because it
# has no TeX source; the TeX source of arXiv:2502.03662v1 labels no theorem, so
# `route_check.py extract` finds no labelled statement in it. The labels are the anchors of the
# FPar1 = Theorem 1 (its proof is FPar2), FPar3 = Theorem 2 (its proof is FPar4).
# The proof of Theorem 2 cites Theorem 1 ("By Theorem 1, for every cluster ..."); the proof of
# Theorem 1 cites no result of the paper.
